entities.summary: Konstantinos "Kostas" Charalampidis is a retired Greek professional basketball player and coach. During his playing career, he was a 6 ft 2 1⁄2 in tall point guard-shooting guard. He last served as an assistant coach for AS Monaco of the French Pro A League and the EuroLeague, under the team's head coach Vassilis Spanoulis.
